data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for adding Google Navigation and map widgets targeting Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides Google Maps navigation and map view widgets for Flutter applications. Supports turning-by-turn navigation sessions, custom camera controls, and route management.
use_when: You need turn-by-turn navigation functionality inside a Flutter application
You want to display Google Maps with built-in navigation and route rendering
avoid_when: You only need basic maps without navigation capabilities
Your target iOS version is lower than 17.0
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms
Provides both full navigation views and standalone map views
weaknesses: Requires complex native setup including specific Gradle versions, Android desugaring, and Swift Package Manager on iOS
Strict minimum OS requirements (Android API 24+, iOS 17.0+)
data.setup_notes: Requires Google Cloud project, API keys configured for Android and iOS, Swift Package Manager on iOS, enabling core library desugaring and specific AGP/Gradle versions on Android.
